04 / About

Artist, musician, producer, dreamer.

reyadreamer is a Jacksonville-based artist, multi-instrumentalist and producer.

As a lifelong musician, nothing matters more to me than seeing an idea come to life. Since middle school, I’ve been preoccupied with guitars, synthesizers, and the strange way music can bring a memory back into focus.

reyadreamer exists to explore that fascination: the glow of the ’80s, the pull of nostalgia, and the endless possibilities inside a song.
